name: terraform-plan-reviewer
description: Reviews a Terraform plan you paste into the chat (`terraform plan` text, `terraform show -json` or `terraform plan -json` lines) and returns a verdict (safe, review or block), the counts, the high- and medium-risk changes, questions to ask the author and a suggested apply order. The plan is parsed in code: destroys or replaces of databases, buckets, volumes, keys and other stateful resources, silent data-loss settings (final snapshot skipped, deletion protection off, versioning suspended), downtime, public exposure and scope creep are found by fixed rules, and a prod destroy of a stateful resource is blocked until you confirm it. It never runs terraform or applies anything, reads only what you paste, and answers no general questions.

skills.name: Review a Terraform plan
skills.description: A safe / review / block verdict on a pasted Terraform plan, with the risky changes, the plan lines behind them, questions for the author and an apply order; follow-ups work on the same review.
examples: Review this prod plan: <paste terraform plan output>
Staging, intent: add an SQS queue. <paste the plan>
Only the high-risk changes, with evidence.
